description: Search everything LeanScale knows: 14 GTM delivery playbooks, 7 proprietary field studies, 143 podcast episodes with operators and executives, 75 customer case studies (anonymized on public keys, named on internal ones), and 117 RevOps docs from www.leanscale.team/knowledge/docs/. The docs explain how to do the work yourself; the playbooks are how LeanScale runs it as an engagement — pass source:"doc" for the first, source:"playbook" for the second. Use this first for any go-to-market, RevOps, sales-ops, marketing-ops, CRM, pipeline, attribution, territory, CPQ, or GTM-tooling question. Returns cited excerpts with source URLs. Also holds the materials from LeanScale's talks, which people ask for by event name: Updata CEO Summit materials: the deck with speaker notes (The Context Graph & Semantic Layer); Updata CEO Summit materials: GTM agents (11 Claude Code plugins for your CRM); Choosing a CRM: migrate off Salesforce, rebuild in place, or stand up a new org; CRM data hygiene: deduplication, merging duplicates and cleaning up workflow and property tech debt; Discovery call structure, mutual action plans and paid vs free pilots; Which paid advertising channel an early-stage B2B startup should use first; Early-stage outbound: prerequisites, sending domains and deliverability, and what to measure; Founder-led sales to the first sales hire: readiness, profile and why first VP of Sales hires fail; Funnel conversion benchmarks: lead to meeting held to closed-won, win rate and sales cycle; GTM reporting readiness checklist: can your CRM measure conversion, velocity, churn, ARR and revenue recognition?; Lead-to-account matching: approaches, match keys and what goes wrong; New account executive ramp plan: 30-60-90 milestones, certification, call shadowing and deal reviews; Separate pipelines for new business, renewal and expansion: deal types, renewal creation and pilots; Partner program operations: PRM implementation, deal registration and cloud marketplace co-sell; Pipeline stage definitions, exit criteria and required fields per stage; How to build pipeline when cold outreach stops working; Selling into a limited TAM: fintech go-to-market for banks and credit unions; Updata CEO Summit materials: metric definitions worksheet (40 GTM definitions); Updata CEO Summit materials — The Context Graph & Semantic Layer. Pass source:"resource" to search only those.
